outcome: Give head of e-commerce / merchandising director a governed method to improve time to resolve delivery inquiries using order milestones, delivery partners and approved policy, with final decisions…
overview: Customer Service Order-Status Assistant addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in retail and e-commerce operations. The first proof of value uses order milestones, delivery partners and approved policy. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is time to resolve delivery inquiries, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: order milestones, delivery partners and approved policy; define time to resolve delivery inquiries and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of E-commerce / Merchandising Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for time to resolve delivery inquiries
